source.integrity: Every image and mask checked against mirror LFS SHA256 and size; license/readme checked against mirror Git blob SHA1 and size; original publisher archive checksum NOT checked
source.note: Course research mirror. Use original train/good for train/calibration only; keep original test untouched.

hash_definition: SHA256 of UTF-8 RGB:width:height: prefix followed by decoded, EXIF-oriented RGB pixel bytes
split_policy: Seeded exact-content-group split of original train/good; original test remains untouched.
limitations: No physical object/product IDs are supplied; different photographs of the same physical product may still cross splits.
Content grouping detects exact decoded-pixel duplicates, not near duplicates or adjacent captures.
Anomaly test labels and masks must never be used to choose model thresholds or quality rules.
